This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Mr. S.R. Rout and associates enter appearance for the informant by filing Vakalatnama in Court today, which is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned counsel for the State as well as learned counsel for the informant.

This is an appeal under section 14-A of S.C. & S.T. (PoA) Act, 1989 in connection with C.T. Case No.147 of 2023 arising out of Purighat P.S. Case No.152 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned Presiding Officer, Special Court under S.C. & S.T. // 2 // (PoA) Act, Cuttack for offences punishable under sections 366/376(1)/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with section 3(2)(v) of the S.C. & S.T.
(PoA) Act.

sentences.text: 1 The appellant moved an application for bail before the learned Presiding Officer, Special Court under S.C. & S.T. (PoA) Act, Cuttack which was rejected on 13.09.2023.

Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the appellant that the appellant is in judicial custody since 28.07.2023 and he has been charge sheeted under sections 366/376(1)/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with section 3(2)(v) of the S.C. & S.T. (PoA) Act and on going through the statement of the victim, who stated about her love affairs with the appellant and staying together in a rented house and keeping physical relationship with the appellant, I am inclined to release the appellant on bail.
Let the appellant be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/-
(rupees fifty thousand) with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin over the matter with further conditions as the learned Court may deem just and proper with further conditions that he shall not keep any contact either with the victim or any of her family members, indulge in any criminal // 3 // activities and shall appear before the learned trial Court on each date to which the case would be posted for trial.
Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
The CRLA is accordingly disposed of.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.

( S.K. Sahoo) Judge PKSahoo Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA Ramachandra Behera vs State Of Odisha & Another on 14 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89470669/
